source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colored = [(c, x) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x]
        for i, (ca, a) in enumerate(colored):
            for cb, b in colored[i+1:]:
                if {a, b} in ({4, 7}, {1, 8}):
                    out[r][cb] = 0
                    out[r][ca+1] = b
    return out
'''
